in_marathi.name: Eeshaan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eeshaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eeshaan is a name derived from Sanskrit, which means 'God's grace'. This name is rooted in Hindu mythology and is often given to a boy as a symbol of divine blessings and protection.
